expected_root_cause: When operateHeaders sees an HTTP/2 HEADERS frame with END_STREAM, it marks the stream read-done but does not enqueue a receive result. The server Recv consumer therefore has no EOF notification and waits indefinitely for a later frame.
fix_summary: Write a recvMsg containing io.EOF when the initial headers end the stream, and add a transport regression test that asserts Recv returns EOF within the timeout.
curation_notes: PR #9391 adds the missing EOF receive message in internal/transport/http2_server.go and a transport-level no-hang regression test.
